name: duopore-public-user-task-plan
description: Sequences your tasks in a supplied day window, respecting explicit dependencies and your priorities. Fits whole tasks and keeps deferred work visible; smaller tasks can fit after a larger one is deferred. Cycles and unknown dependencies are rejected. Uses only adult user-controlled facts; review the result. No external lookup, storage or sending.

interface.longDescription: Sequences your tasks in a supplied day window, respecting explicit dependencies and your priorities. Fits whole tasks and keeps deferred work visible; smaller tasks can fit after a larger one is deferred. Cycles and unknown dependencies are rejected. Uses only adult user-controlled facts; review the result. No external lookup, storage or sending. Uses explicitly supplied structured inputs. Server computations are transient; the standalone website computes locally in your browser. Review the output before exporting it. No persistent account records, external source retrieval, sending, transactions or paid model calls. CSV/JSON review and export are available on the standalone website. MCP requests are capped at 128 KiB and computed responses at 256 KiB; individual field and record limits also apply.
